components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The singular violet action for the next consequential step.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary-button" type="button">Start local Möbius <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary-button { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; color: var(--paper, #fff); background: var(--violet, #5c36ee); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 620; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(69, 33, 199, 0.18); cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-primary-button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-primary-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--violet-deep, #4521c7); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(92, 54, 238, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-primary-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.48; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered paper action for additive, recovery, and utility tasks.
components.html: <button class="ds-secondary-button" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Add folder</button>
components.css: .ds-secondary-button { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c9c2d2); border-radius: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink, #17151c); background: var(--paper, #fff); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 580; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-secondary-button svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-secondary-button:hover { border-color: #a99db8; background: #faf9fc; } .ds-secondary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(92, 54, 238, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-secondary-button:active { background: #f0edf3; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A plain, high-clarity field for names and deployment addresses.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: min(100%, 520px); color: var(--ink-soft, #46424d); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 620; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 46px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c9c2d2); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink, #17151c); background: var(--paper, #fff); font: 400 16px/1.4 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #6f6a76); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #ada4b8; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--violet, #5c36ee); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(92, 54, 238, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Back Navigation
components.description: A quiet inline return action that precedes every detail heading.
components.css: .ds-back { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 6px 0; border: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #46424d); background: transparent; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 550; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-back svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-back:hover { color: var(--violet, #5c36ee); } .ds-back:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(92, 54, 238, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-back:active { color: var(--violet-deep, #4521c7); }

components.name: Recommendation Chip
components.description: A tiny contextual label used only inside the hosted recommendation.
components.css: .ds-recommended { display: inline-block; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--paper, #fff); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Hosted Choice
components.description: The featured decision surface that makes the durable hosted home visibly first.
components.css: .ds-hosted-choice { position: relative; overflow: hidden; width: 100%; min-height: 132px; padding: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 20px; color: var(--paper, #fff); background: var(--violet, #5c36ee); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(69, 33, 199, 0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), box-shadow 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-hosted-choice::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 170px; height: 170px; right: 6%; top: -82%; border: 32px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 50%; transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-hosted-icon { width: 50px; height: 50px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-hosted-icon svg, .ds-hosted-arrow { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-hosted-icon svg { width: 25px; height: 25px; } .ds-hosted-arrow { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-hosted-copy { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; } .ds-hosted-copy > span { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; } .ds-hosted-copy strong { font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-hosted-copy em { padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-hosted-copy small { color: #e8e1ff; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-hosted-choice:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--violet-deep, #4521c7); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(69, 33, 199, 0.28); } .ds-hosted-choice:hover::after { transform: translate(-16px, 34px) scale(1.1); } .ds-hosted-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(92, 54, 238, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-hosted-choice:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Alternative Rail Choice
components.description: A flat full-width route for honest alternatives beneath the hosted choice.
components.css: .ds-rail-choice { width: 100%; padding: 20px 8px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #ddd9e2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #ddd9e2); display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 18px; color: var(--ink, #17151c); background: transparent; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-icon { width: 50px; height: 50px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 14px; color: var(--violet, #5c36ee); background: var(--violet-soft, #ece8ff); } .ds-rail-icon svg { width: 25px; height: 25px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-rail-copy { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; } .ds-rail-copy strong { font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-rail-copy small { color: var(--muted, #6f6a76); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-rail-arrow { width: 24px; height: 24px; color: var(--muted, #6f6a76); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-rail-choice:hover { background: #faf9fc; } .ds-rail-choice:hover .ds-rail-arrow { color: var(--violet, #5c36ee); transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-rail-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(92, 54, 238, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-choice:active { background: #f0edf3; }

components.name: Local Durability Warning
components.description: A flat violet field that states the local runtime boundary before local controls.
components.html:
Local mode is not a persistent home for your agent.

It is unavailable when this computer or Docker is off.
components.css: .ds-local-warning { padding: 18px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: start; gap: 16px; color: #352552; background: #efeaff; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-local-warning > svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--violet, #5c36ee); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-local-warning strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-local-warning p { margin: 6px 0 0; max-width: 58ch; color: #665677; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-local-warning button { border: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--violet-deep, #4521c7); background: transparent; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 620; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-local-warning button:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-local-warning button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(92, 54, 238, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-local-warning button:active { color: var(--plum, #2b1058); }

components.name: Folder Access Toggle
components.description: A compact explicit authority control for read-only versus read-and-edit access.
components.css: .ds-access-toggle { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 9px; background: #f0edf2; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-access-toggle button { height: 28px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--muted, #6f6a76); background: transparent; font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-access-toggle button:hover { color: var(--ink, #17151c); } .ds-access-toggle button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(92, 54, 238, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-access-toggle button.ds-active { color: var(--ink, #17151c); background: var(--paper, #fff); box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(23, 21, 28, 0.1); } .ds-access-toggle button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

narrative.overview:
Möbius Desktop is an inherited Möbius operating surface: calm, direct, and visibly owner-controlled. A deep-plum ownership field carries the canonical white mark and one plain-language promise, while a paper decision plane keeps setup legible and task-first. Broad continuous planes, crisp rails, and a single violet action voice make the interface feel authored without turning it into a marketing page.

Hosted leads because it is the durable home, but existing and local paths remain visually present and truthfully described. Character comes from decisive scale, restrained violet geometry, and purposeful motion rather than decoration. The system should always feel like a doorway into a Möbius—not a generic browser-wrapper dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-plum ownership field paired with a paper/cloud decision plane.
Möbius violet reserved as the singular action voice.
Broad continuous surfaces and crisp divider rails instead of card grids.
Oversized, tightly set Inter headlines with compact operational copy.
Hosted leads; existing and local alternatives remain honest and usable.
Motion is restrained, authored, and fully suppressed for reduced-motion users.

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet signals a consequential or selected action; do not distribute it across passive decoration.

rules.name: The Ownership Field Rule
rules.body: Plum identifies the Möbius-owned side of the doorway and never competes with the paper task plane for interaction.

rules.name: The State Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green and red communicate state only when shape, iconography, or plain language carries the same meaning.

rules.name: The Tight Headline Rule
rules.body: Major headlines use strong weight, near-solid leading, and -0.04em tracking; never dilute them with extra labels or decorative type.

rules.name: The Plain-Language Rule
rules.body: Operational copy stays sentence-case, concrete, and short enough to scan beside the next action.

rules.name: The Two-Plane Rule
rules.body: Brand and task occupy continuous fields; do not subdivide the paper plane into a generic card grid.

rules.name: The Compact-Preserves-Priority Rule
rules.body: Responsive layout may stack and wrap, but hosted remains first, warnings remain before local controls, and actions stay adjacent to the objects they affect.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a border, tonal field, or whitespace can establish the hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The One Broad Gesture Rule
rules.body: Use one large cropped violet form to give the ownership field life; do not repeat circles, blobs, or ornaments across the task plane.

dos: Do keep plum for ownership, paper for decisions, and violet for consequential action.
Do lead with the hosted path while keeping existing and local routes fully visible and plainly described.
Do use divider rails for operational lists and tonal fields for warnings, reminders, and status.
Do retain the canonical white Möbius mark and Inter product typography.
Do preserve keyboard focus, non-color status cues, compact-window hierarchy, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do let one restrained motion or geometric gesture carry character while the workflow remains still and legible.
donts: Don't turn the task plane into a dashboard of floating cards or a generic embedded-browser frame.
Don't use violet as ambient decoration, secondary metadata, or passive status; its rarity creates authority.
Don't make local mode look equivalent to an always-on home or bury its durability warning.
Don't introduce alternate display faces, gradients, glass effects, or ornamental icon families.
Don't add shadows to ordinary rows, fields, warnings, or neutral containers.
Don't let compact layouts crop actions, truncate essential guidance, or reorder decision priority.
